definitions.explanation: The middle day of the work week. The kanji 水 means 'water' and relates to Mercury (the 'water planet' in East Asian tradition).

examples.japanese: {水曜日|すいようび}に{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ます。
examples.english: I'll watch a movie on Wednesday.

examples.japanese: {水曜日|すいようび}は{何|なに}をしますか。
examples.english: What will you do on Wednesday?

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}の{水曜日|すいようび}は{休|やす}みです。
examples.english: This Wednesday is a day off.

examples.japanese: {水曜日|すいようび}の{午後|ごご}は{仕事|しごと}が{終|お}わってから{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: On Wednesday afternoon, I go shopping after work.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{水曜日|すいようび}は{日本語|にほんご}の{授業|じゅぎょう}があります。
examples.english: I have Japanese class every Wednesday.

notes:
{水曜日|すいようび} is Wednesday, the third day of the Japanese week.

ETYMOLOGY:
{水|すい} (water) + {曜日|ようび} (day of the week). Based on the planet Mercury, called {水星|すいせい} (water star) in Japanese.

FORMS:
- Full: {水曜日|すいようび}
- Abbreviated: {水曜|すいよう} or just {水|すい}

DAYS OF THE WEEK:
- {日曜日|にちようび} (Sun), {月曜日|げつようび} (Mon), {火曜日|かようび} (Tue)
- {水曜日|すいようび} (Wed), {木曜日|もくようび} (Thu)
- {金曜日|きんようび} (Fri), {土曜日|どようび} (Sat)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {毎週|まいしゅう}{水曜日|すいようび}: every Wednesday
- {水曜日|すいようび}に: on Wednesday
- {今週|こんしゅう}の{水曜日|すいようび}: this Wednesday
